_comment: The graded W6+SH arm RE-RUN with the §1.5 cbpin= fill built (NetworkSolPrep).
The first graded run (runs/simnet300_wsh_n50_graded) emitted 466/480 epochs and was
then UNGRADEABLE on its headline channel: the S line declared no IF-pin pair, so the
§4.4 two-stage S-transform could not be applied to the truth and the grader refused
(correctly) to assume (C1C,C2W).  Same posture, same fixture, one build apart.
